Module io.github.jpersist.tools.hibernate.orm
Package hibernate.jakarta.persistence.tools.internal

Class NoOpConnectionProvider

java.lang.Object
hibernate.jakarta.persistence.tools.internal.NoOpConnectionProvider
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, org.hibernate.engine.jdbc.connections.spi.ConnectionProvider, org.hibernate.service.Service, org.hibernate.service.spi.Wrapped
public final class NoOpConnectionProvider extends Object implements org.hibernate.engine.jdbc.connections.spi.ConnectionProvider
A no-op ConnectionProvider for offline build-time metadata and query validation where no live database connection is available or required.

Configuring this provider suppresses HHH000181 startup logs while preventing accidental JDBC connection attempts during offline linting.

Since:
2.1.0
